acceptance: A unit test with an injected parent environment of 3 non-allowlisted variables at stage enforce gets exactly one INFO event that names all 3, and no WARN, red before the change
The same test at stage shadow gets one WARN per variable, as today

consumed.resolution: already done on main (verified by the inbox review of 2026-11-20, adversarial pass): Enforce now emits one INFO ISOLATION_ENV_REFUSED per dispatch and keeps per-variable WARN only at shadow.

fix: At stage enforce, emit one INFO event per dispatch (code ISOLATION_ENV_REFUSED or the I2 code at INFO) with the refused count and the sorted names in one field. Keep the per-variable WARN only at stage shadow, where the variable does reach the cell. Register the code in signalcenter and regenerate signal-codes.md.
summary: Wave 181 (cycles 2522-2542) emitted 2480 WARN ISOLATION_I2_VIOLATION signals, 61% of all its non-INFO signals. Each one is a launcher variable (CLAUDECODE, BRAVE_API_KEY, ANDROID_HOME, ...) that Deps.reportDroppedEnv (go/internal/bridge/hermetic_env.go:236) reports with action=refused at stage enforce. A refusal at enforce is the invariant working, not a breach: the cell never got the variable. EnvDrops.firstSeen dedupes only inside one process, so every evolve agent run and every phase dispatch repeats about 60 WARN events. A real I2 breach (a variable that reached a cell) is then one line in thousands.
title: An env variable that the enforce stage refuses is emitted as a WARN violation, one per variable per dispatch, so 2480 WARNs hide the real ones
